valid_signed_op_exists.meaning: a valid 77-byte signed UserOperation exists whose owner signature covers only the 65-byte rawSignature and userOpHash

relayer_holds_op.meaning: a relayer/bundler holds that valid 77-byte signed operation

suffix_excluded_from_hash.meaning: getUserOpHash excludes the signature field so the last 12 bytes (validUntil/validAfter suffix) are not part of userOpHash

window_enforced.meaning: the signer's intended validUntil/validAfter time restriction is enforced on the executed operation
window_enforced.checkpoint: at validation/execution of the modified UserOperation

assumptions: The relayer rewrites the 12-byte validUntil/validAfter suffix of userOp.signature before submission.
The modified UserOperation is submitted for validation and execution.
AtomWallet verifies the owner signature only over userOpHash and the stripped 65-byte rawSignature, never authenticating the last 12 bytes.

unresolved.description: Report does not give concrete validUntil/validAfter values or the original signer-approved window bounds, so the window is represented as a grounded Boolean enforcement condition rather than numeric time comparisons.

limitations: The window enforcement is modeled as a Boolean observable because the report supplies no numeric validUntil/validAfter values.
Only the i_window_not_enforced impact is formalized; other listed impacts are handled in separate passes.
